   153	
   154	noncomputable section
   155	
   156	/-! ## The naturality step, named -/
   157	
   158	/-- **A chart map read at an opens inclusion.**
   159	
   160	`f.app` at the open `W` applied to `W.ι ≫ u` is the restriction along `W.ι` of `f.app` at the
   161	whole scheme applied to `u`.  This is `NatTrans.naturality_apply` at `(W.ι).op`, with the
   162	`yoneda`-side map being precomposition.
   163	
   164	Named rather than inlined because the `yoneda`-side unfolding is the only thing that has to be
   165	got right: an attempt to use the Σ-sheaf's own restriction on the wrong side does not typecheck.
   166	(An earlier version said "all three refutations below consume it".  **One** does — the others
   167	reach it only transitively through the main theorem.) -/
   168	theorem chart_map_ι_apply {X : Scheme.{u}}
   169	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (W : X.Opens) (u : X ⟶ X) :
   170	    (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.map (W.ι).op (f.app (op X) u)
   171	      = f.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (W.ι ≫ u) :=
   172	  (NatTrans.naturality_apply f (W.ι).op u).symm
   173	
   174	/-! ## The step -/
   175	
   176	variable (C) in
   177	/-- **COVERAGE AT A PROPER `V` FORCES NON-INJECTIVITY OF THE UNRESTRICTED MAP.**
   178	
   179	For an arbitrary map of big-site presheaves `f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ pic0SigmaSheaf C` and an open
   180	`V ≠ ⊤`: if the one-chart family `restrictChart f V` satisfies `PointwiseCoverage`, then `f`
   181	fails to be injective on some test.
   182	
   183	The proof is the tautological section at the test `X`, read at a point outside `V`; see the
   184	module docstring.  No divisor, no chart index, no `rep`, no `pic⁰` fact is used — only that a
   185	coverage witness factors through `V` and the identity does not.
   186	
   187	Note the hypothesis is coverage for the family *restricted to `V`*, which is what the seam
   188	consumes at a restricted atlas (`Pic0ChartAtlasCoupling.liftPointwiseToOpens`), not
   189	unrestricted coverage. -/
   190	theorem not_injective_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top
   191	    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (V : X.Opens)
   192	    (hV : V ≠ ⊤)
   193	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => restrictChart f V)) :
   194	    ∃ T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ, ¬ Function.Injective (f.app T) := by
   195	  -- `V ≠ ⊤` gives a point of `X` outside `V`
   196	  obtain ⟨t, htV⟩ : ∃ t : X, t ∉ V := by
   197	    by_contra h
   198	    exact hV (top_le_iff.mp fun t _ => not_not.mp fun ht => h ⟨t, ht⟩)
   199	  obtain ⟨W, htW, iu, x, hx⟩ := hcov X (f.app (op X) (𝟙 X)) t
   200	  refine ⟨op (W : Scheme.{u}), fun hinj => ?_⟩
   201	  -- the coverage witness and the identity have the same chart value over `W`
   202	  have hxv : f.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (x ≫ V.ι)
   203	      = f.app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (W.ι ≫ 𝟙 X) := by
   204	    rw [← chart_map_ι_apply f W (𝟙 X)]
   205	    exact hx
   206	  have heq := hinj hxv
   207	  -- but they disagree at `t`: the witness lands in `V` and `t` does not
   208	  have hpt : ((x ≫ V.ι).base ⟨t, htW⟩ : X) = ((W.ι ≫ 𝟙 X).base ⟨t, htW⟩ : X) := by
   209	    rw [heq]
   210	  have hmem : ((x ≫ V.ι).base ⟨t, htW⟩ : X) ∈ V := (x.base ⟨t, htW⟩).2
   211	  rw [hpt] at hmem
   212	  exact htV (by simpa using hmem)
   213	
   214	variable (C) in
   215	/-- **The contrapositive: injectivity confines coverage to `V = ⊤`.**
   216	
   217	If a chart map is injective on every test, then no proper open supports coverage for its
   218	restriction.  Read with `not_coverageContainment_bot` — which refutes the containment at `⊥` —
   219	this says an injective chart leaves exactly one candidate value of `V`, namely `⊤`.
   220	
   221	This is the form the fork's *positive* branch reads, and the reason this file's finding is not
   222	one-sided: the branch that the `abel-noninj` row argues for (uniqueness of the degree-`g`
   223	representative, hence injectivity) is the branch that kills the restriction apparatus. -/
   224	theorem not_pointwiseCoverage_of_injective_of_ne_top
   225	    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (V : X.Opens)
   226	    (hV : V ≠ ⊤) (hinj : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (f.app T)) :
   227	    ¬ PointwiseCoverage C (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => restrictChart f V) := by
   228	  intro hcov
   229	  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := not_injective_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top C f V hV hcov
   230	  exact hT (hinj T)
   231	
   232	/-! ## The compositions at the Abel chart
   233	
   234	The two theorems above are about an arbitrary presheaf map.  Instantiated at `abelSigmaChart`
   235	they close the `⊤` end of the `V`-interval *unconditionally on the fork*, which is what makes
   236	the fork and the interval one question. -/
   237	
   238	variable (C π n) in
   239	/-- **Coverage at a proper `V` kills the `⊤` end.**
   240	
   241	`not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_not_injective` (`Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean`) needs
   242	a test on which the Abel chart is not injective, and says so conditionally — the `abel-noninj`
   243	fork.  Coverage at any proper `V` *supplies* that test, by
   244	`not_injective_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top`.
   245	
   246	So a lane holding coverage at a proper `V` does not have to decide the fork to know that
   247	`V = ⊤` is dead: coverage decides it. -/
   248	theorem not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top
   249	    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   250	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   251	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   252	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   253	    (V : D.left.Opens) (hV : V ≠ ⊤)
   254	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C
   255	      (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => restrictChart (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) V)) :
   256	    ¬ RestrictedChartFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg ⊤ := by
   257	  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := not_injective_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top C
   258	    (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) V hV hcov
   259	  exact not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_not_injective rep m Z hdeg T hT
   260	
   261	variable (C π n) in
   262	/-- **Coverage at a proper `V` kills `IsChartLocusFibre`** — the old route to antecedent 1.
   263	
   264	Composite of the previous theorem with `restrictedChartFibre_top_iff`
   265	(`Pic0ChartRestrictedFibreSat.lean`), which identifies `IsChartLocusFibre` with the `⊤`
   266	instance of the restricted class.
   267	
   268	This is the sharp statement of the finding: the guard
   269	`not_isChartLocusFibre_of_not_injective` was waiting on two divisors in one linear system, and
   270	coverage at a proper open produces the same conclusion with no divisor at all. -/
   271	theorem not_isChartLocusFibre_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top
   272	    {D : Over (Spec (.of k))} (rep : (divFunctor C π n).RepresentableBy D)
   273	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   274	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   275	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   276	    (V : D.left.Opens) (hV : V ≠ ⊤)
   277	    (hcov : PointwiseCoverage C
   278	      (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} => restrictChart (abelSigmaChart C π n rep m Z hdeg) V)) :
   279	    ¬ IsChartLocusFibre C π n rep m Z hdeg := fun h =>
   280	  not_restrictedChartFibre_top_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top C π n rep m Z hdeg V hV hcov
   281	    ((restrictedChartFibre_top_iff C π n rep m Z hdeg).mpr h)
   282	
   283	/-! ## Non-vacuity: the conclusion is not free, at a pair the theorem quantifies over
   284	
   285	`not_injective_of_pointwiseCoverage_of_ne_top` concludes "some test where `f` is not injective".
   286	If that held for *every* `(f, V)` with `V ≠ ⊤`, the theorem would carry no information.
   287	
   288	The witness has to satisfy **both** binders: `f` injective on every test, *and* a source with a
   289	proper open.  The obvious candidate — `restrictChart f ⊥`, injective by the open-immersion
   290	criterion — satisfies the first and **fails the second**, since `↥(⊥ : X.Opens)` has a
   291	subsingleton open lattice and so admits no `V ≠ ⊤`.  (It is also injective for free, `yoneda.obj
   292	↥⊥` being subsingleton-valued, so the criterion adds nothing there.)  The witness below is
   293	`Spec k` with the tautological section, which has both. -/
   294	
   295	variable (C) in
   296	/-- **The tautological Σ-section over `Spec k`**: the identity structure morphism paired with the
   297	identity class.  Degree-zero needs nothing about the curve.
   298	
   299	Same construction as `Pic0ChartBotRefute.specSigmaSection`, which is not in this file's import
   300	closure; recorded here rather than importing that file, since only the section is wanted and not
   301	its `⊥` refutation. -/
   302	def specSigmaSectionTaut :
   303	    (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1.obj (op (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :=
   304	  ⟨𝟙 _, 1⟩
   305	
   306	/-- **`Spec k` has a proper open** — the binder the `⊥` witness could not supply.
   307	
   308	`k` is a field, so `Spec k` has a point, so `⊥ ≠ ⊤` there. -/
   309	theorem bot_ne_top_specObj : (⊥ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) ≠ ⊤ := by
   310	  intro h
   311	  have hne : Nonempty (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
   312	    inferInstanceAs (Nonempty (PrimeSpectrum k))
   313	  have hm : hne.some ∈ (⊥ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens) := by rw [h]; trivial
   314	  exact hm
   315	
   316	variable (C) in
   317	/-- **THE NON-VACUITY WITNESS**: the map named by the tautological section is injective on every
   318	test, and its source has a proper open.
   319	
   320	Injectivity is one step: the Σ-component of the section's restriction along `u` is `u ≫ 𝟙 = u`
   321	(`Over.sigmaExtension_map_fst`), so the map's first component recovers its own argument.
   322	
   323	Composed with `not_pointwiseCoverage_of_injective_of_ne_top` and `bot_ne_top_specObj` this
   324	*refutes* coverage at `⊥ ≠ ⊤` on this source — so the theorem's conclusion genuinely fails for
   325	some pair it quantifies over, which is what non-vacuity here means. -/
   326	theorem specSecMap_injective :
   327	    ∀ T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ,
   328	      Function.Injective
   329	        ((yonedaEquiv.symm (specSigmaSectionTaut C)).app T) := by
   330	  intro T u v h
   331	  have h1 : ((yonedaEquiv.symm (specSigmaSectionTaut C)).app T u).1
   332	      = ((yonedaEquiv.symm (specSigmaSectionTaut C)).app T v).1 := by rw [h]
   333	  have key : ∀ w : (yoneda.obj (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).obj T,
   334	      ((yonedaEquiv.symm (specSigmaSectionTaut C)).app T w).1 = w := by
   335	    intro w
   336	    show ((Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (pic0TypeFunctor C)).map
   337	      (Quiver.Hom.op w) (specSigmaSectionTaut C)).1 = w
   338	    rw [Over.sigmaExtension_map_fst]
   339	    simp [specSigmaSectionTaut]
   340	  rw [key u, key v] at h1
   341	  exact h1
   342	
   343	variable (C) in
   344	/-- **Coverage is refuted outright at this witness** — the non-vacuity check in the form that
   345	uses the theorem rather than merely accompanying it. -/
   346	theorem not_pointwiseCoverage_specSecMap :
   347	    ¬ PointwiseCoverage C (fun _ : PUnit.{u+1} =>
   348	        restrictChart (yonedaEquiv.symm (specSigmaSectionTaut C))
   349	          (⊥ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).Opens)) :=
   350	  not_pointwiseCoverage_of_injective_of_ne_top C _ _ bot_ne_top_specObj
   351	    (specSecMap_injective C)
   352	
   353	/-! ## The old, mis-aimed witness, kept with its defect named
   354	
   355	Retained rather than deleted because a lane reading the audit trail should be able to see what
   356	was wrong with it: it is true, and it is about a pair the theorem cannot be instantiated at. -/
   357	
   358	variable (C) in
   359	/-- **True but off-target**: `restrictChart f ⊥` is injective on every test.
   360	
   361	This was this file's original non-vacuity check and it does not serve that purpose — see the
   362	section header above and `I-1380`.  Kept because it is the shape a reader will reach for. -/
   363	theorem injective_restrictChart_bot {X : Scheme.{u}}
   364	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) :
   365	    ∀ T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ,
   366	      Function.Injective ((restrictChart f (⊥ : X.Opens)).app T) :=
   367	  fun T => injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf
   368	    (isOpenImmersion_presheaf_restrictChart_bot C f) T
   369

    62	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=

    73	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
    74	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
    75	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
    76	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
    77	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=

    92	dominant map to `P1`, the cohomology finiteness instances, and the Euler-characteristic identities
    93	are all chosen internally from the curve assumptions. -/

    95	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)), (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy D := by
    96	  classical

    98	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=

   101	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   102	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)

   114	/-- A chosen scheme representing the widened divisor functor at the curve's genus. -/

   117	
   118	/-- The widened divisor functor at the genus of a challenge curve is representable, with no
   119	additional hypotheses. -/
   120	noncomputable def divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy :
   121	    (divFunctorAff C (genus C)).RepresentableBy (divRepAffGenusScheme C) :=
   122	  (divFunctorAffGenusRepresenter C).2

   124	/-- A representer for the widened divisor functor at the unconditional Picard coverage
   125	parameter. The curve genus controls Euler-characteristic normalization independently of the
   126	larger divisor degree. -/
   127	noncomputable def divFunctorAffAdmissibleRepresenter :
   128	    Σ D : Over (Spec (.of k)),
   129	      (divFunctorAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)).RepresentableBy D := by

   131	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom

   138	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)

   140	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   141	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   142	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C

   146	    (C := C) (pi := divRepAffP1Map C) (hpi := hpi)
   147	    (g := divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C) (hO := h0_moduleKSheaf C)

   152	coverage parameter. -/
   153	noncomputable def divRepAffAdmissibleScheme : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   154	  (divFunctorAffAdmissibleRepresenter C).1

   157	without any additional curve, divisor-degree, or rational-point hypothesis. -/

   159	    (divFunctorAff C (divRepAffAdmissibleParameter C)).RepresentableBy
   160	      (divRepAffAdmissibleScheme C) :=

     8	/-!
     9	# The section rank at a chart-locus point
    10	
    11	`Pic0ChartLocusH0One` specializes the chart parameter to the genus and obtains the
    12	unique-effective-representative value `h⁰ = 1`.  This file records the unspecialized
    13	calculation.  If the chart parameter is `n` and the curve has Euler characteristic
    14	`1 - g`, the vanishing witness extracted from `chartLocus` has
    15	
    16	`h⁰ = n + 1 - g`.
    17	
    18	This separates two roles that a coverage argument must not conflate: a large parameter can
    19	force `H¹`-vanishing, while the injective Abel chart needs the genus parameter, where the
    20	same rank formula becomes `h⁰ = 1`.
    21	-/

    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    40	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    41	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    42	
    43	noncomputable section
    44	
    45	/-- Chart-locus membership at parameter `n` supplies a witness of section rank `n + 1 - g` on a
    46	curve with Euler characteristic `1 - g`.
    47	
    48	The conclusion retains the presentation, divisor-class, degree, and vanishing clauses from
    49	`IsSplitWitness`; consequently it is tied to the given class and cannot be inhabited by an
    50	unrelated trivial divisor. -/
    51	theorem exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
    52	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
    53	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
    54	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
    55	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
    56	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    57	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0)
    58	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
    59	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
    60	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
    61	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
    62	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
    63	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
    64	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
    65	      PicEtAff.map C L
    66	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
    67	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
    68	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
    69	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
    71	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
    72	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
    73	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ)
    74	        = (n : ℤ) + 1 - (g : ℤ) := by
    75	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, hM, W, hWcl, hWh1⟩ := ht
    76	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    77	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    78	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    79	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    80	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    81	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
    82	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
    83	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
    84	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
    85	  have hWdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) := by
    86	    rw [← classDeg_picClass (K := L) W, hWcl,
    87	      classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ M hM]
    88	    change degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) (Over.testPoint t) = (n : ℤ)
    89	    rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
    90	      degAt_sigmaFamily, hlam, hdeg]
    91	    ring
    92	  have hχL : Sheaf.chi (((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (g : ℤ) :=
    93	    chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hχ
    94	  have hrank := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := L) W hWh1
    95	  rw [hWdeg, hχL] at hrank
    96	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
    97	  omega
    98	
    99	/-- Above the genus parameter, chart-locus membership supplies a witness with at least two
   100	sections.  Thus the
   101	large-parameter vanishing route and the `h⁰ = 1` uniqueness route are genuinely different
   102	branches of the representability argument. -/
   103	theorem exists_splitting_two_le_h0_of_mem_chartLocus
   104	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left)
   105	    (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (n g : ℕ)
   106	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   107	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - (n : ℤ))
   108	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   109	    (hlam : degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0) (hgn : g < n)
   110	    (ht : t ∈ chartLocus C m Z lam) :
   111	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)
   112	        (_ : IsScalarTower k (Over.testPointField t) L)
   113	        (_ : Module.Finite (Over.testPointField t) L)
   114	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)
   115	        (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   116	        (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   117	      PicEtAff.map C L
   118	          (picEtAffineEquiv C (Over.testPointField t)
   119	            (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam)))
   120	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M) ∧
   121	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M ∧
   122	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W = (n : ℤ) ∧
   123	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   124	        ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧
   125	      2 ≤ Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) := by
   126	  obtain ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1,
   127	      hrank⟩ := exists_splitting_h0_formula_of_mem_chartLocus
   128	        lam t m Z n g hdeg hχ hlam ht
   129	  refine ⟨L, hLf, hLa, hLKa, hLtow, hLfin, hLsep, M, W, hM, hWcl, hWdeg, hWh1, ?_⟩
   130	  have htwo : (2 : ℤ) ≤
   131	      (Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) : ℤ) := by
   132	    rw [hrank]
   133	    omega
   134	  exact_mod_cast htwo

   136	/-! ## The actual unconditional coverage parameter -/
   137	
   138	/-- On a positive-genus curve, the unconditional admissible coverage parameter is strictly
   139	larger than the genus.
   140	
   141	The strictness does not add a cohomological hypothesis: `h⁰(𝒪_C) = 1` follows from the standing
   142	proper, smooth, geometrically irreducible assumptions.  If the ledger contribution above `g`
   143	were nonpositive, `genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos` would contradict `g ≠ 0`. -/
   144	theorem genus_lt_admissibleCoverageParameter_of_ne_zero
   145	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   146	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   147	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   148	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   149	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   150	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   151	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   152	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   153	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   154	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   155	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   156	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   157	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   158	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   159	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   160	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   161	    g < admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g := by
   162	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   163	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   164	    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   165	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   166	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   167	    inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   168	  haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   169	    inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   170	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   171	    moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   172	  haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   173	    moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   174	  have hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 := h0_moduleKSheaf C
   175	  have hb : 0 < windowBound π hπ := by
   176	    by_contra hnonpos
   177	    exact hg (genus_eq_zero_of_windowBound_nonpos π hπ g

   181	      (windowM_choice π hπ g : ℤ) * windowδ π + (g : ℤ) := by

   184	  have hcast : (g : ℤ) <
   185	      (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) :=
   186	    hledger.trans_le hadmissible
   187	  exact_mod_cast hcast

   189	/-- For positive genus, the uniform full-locus coverage chart supplies a splitting witness with
   190	at least two sections at every degree-zero fibre point.
   191	
   192	This is the direct join between `exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart` and the rank formula:

   194	genus-parameter `h⁰ = 1` chart used by the unique-effective-representative route. -/
   195	theorem exists_uniform_admissibleCoverageChart_two_le_h0
   196	    {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
   197	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
   198	    (g : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
   199	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ)) :
   200	    letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
   201	    haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   202	      inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
   203	    haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   204	    haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   205	      inferInstanceAs (LocallyOfFiniteType C.hom)
   206	    haveI : QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=
   207	      inferInstanceAs (QuasiCompact C.hom)
   208	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0) :=
   209	      moduleFinite_hModule_zero C
   210	    haveI : Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1) :=
   211	      moduleFinite_hModule_one C
   212	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor),
   213	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z
   214	          = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C)
   215	            - (admissibleCoverageParameter (C := C) hπ g : ℤ) ∧
   216	        ∀ {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) (t : T.left),
   217	          degAt lam (Over.testPoint t) = 0 →
   218	            ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L)
   219	                (_ : Algebra (Over.testPointField t) L)

   222	                (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable (Over.testPointField t) L)

   224	                (W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),

   233	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1) ∧

   238	  haveI : IsIntegral C.left := isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced C
   239	  haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k)) :=

     8	/-!
     9	# C9b: what `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` of a chart map actually asks for
    10	
    11	`Picard/Pic0ChartPair.lean` pins `IsChartUniv` — the `hf` half of the `(f, hf)` pair that
    12	`pic0RepresentableByOfCharts` consumes — and its docstring, together with the `c9b` roadmap
    13	row, prices it as **one** obligation: the relative form of DAT-C GAP-2 plus the classifier,
    14	CERT-Σ-gated.
    15	
    16	**That pricing is wrong, and this file is the correction.**  `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is
    17	`MorphismProperty.relative` at `yoneda` (mathlib `MorphismProperty/Representable.lean`), and
    18	`relative` is *by definition* a conjunction of two independent statements:
    19	
    20	1. **relative representability** — for every test `T` and every `g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ 𝓟`, the
    21	   fibre product of the chart map along `g` is representable *by a scheme*;
    22	2. **the property clause** — every represented pullback is an open immersion of schemes.
    23	
    24	The GAP-2/classifier story is the input to (2) only: it is what makes the fibre a single
    25	point, hence the represented pullback an open subscheme.  It says nothing about (1), which
    26	is a representability statement about a fibre product.  Read as one clause, a lane waits on
    27	CERT-Σ for both halves.  Read as two, half of the work is stateable and provable *now*, with
    28	no divisor-representability endpoint and no certificate anywhere in it.
    29	
    30	## What this file provides, and what it deliberately does not
    31	
    32	Everything here is stated for an **arbitrary** morphism of big-site presheaves
    33	`f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1` and an **arbitrary** open `V ⊆ X`.  No `divRep`
    34	endpoint, no certificate, no `Z`, no `θ` and no chart index appears in any statement.  That
    35	is the point: `IsChartUniv` becomes *this criterion instantiated at* `abelSigmaChart`, and
    36	the divisor-representability shape enters only at the instantiation.
    37	
    38	The criterion's hypotheses are **elementwise** conditions on the presheaf — a fibrewise
    39	injectivity clause and a clause producing the representing open — because that is what
    40	mathlib's `MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists` reduces the goal to once the presheaf
    41	category's pullbacks are computed pointwise (`Types.isPullback_iff`).
    42	
    43	## Main declarations
    44	
    45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ChartFibrePresented` — the elementwise datum (1) needs: for each test
    46	  point `g` of the target, an open `W` of the test and an identification of the `W`-points
    47	  with the chart points hitting `g`.  This is the *shape* of a fibre-product presentation,
    48	  named so that a producer knows exactly what it owes.
    49	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented` — **the criterion**:
    50	  a `ChartFibrePresented` datum gives `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f`, discharging BOTH clauses
    51	  at once.  Certificate-free and divRep-free.
    52	* `AlgebraicGeometry.mono_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf` — the converse direction that makes
    53	  the split honest: `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f` *implies* `f` is a monomorphism.  So "the
    54	  Abel map is not a monomorphism", which three files cite as the reason the unrestricted
    55	  certificate fails, is a consequence of the criterion rather than an extra obligation — and
    56	  it shows the elementwise injectivity clause below is **necessary**, not an artefact of
    57	  this route.
    58	* `AlgebraicGeometry.injective_of_isOpenImmersion_presheaf` — the same fact in the
    59	  elementwise form a chart-locus argument can actually use.
    60	-/
    61	
    62	set_option autoImplicit false
    63	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    64	
    65	universe u
    66	
    67	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    68	
    69	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    70	
    71	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    72	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    73	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    74	
    75	noncomputable section
    76	
    77	/-! ## The necessary direction: an open immersion of presheaves is a monomorphism
    78	
    79	Stated first, because it is what tells us the criterion below asks for the right thing. -/
    80	
    81	/-- **An open immersion of presheaves out of a representable is a monomorphism.**

   111	
   112	variable (C) in
   113	/-- **The fibre of a chart map over one test point, presented by an open of the test.**
   114	
   115	This is the datum mathlib's `relative.of_exists` asks for at a single
   116	`g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ pic0SigmaSheaf C`, written out so a producer can see exactly what it
   117	owes.  Given a chart map `f` out of `X`:
   118	
   119	* `W` is an open subscheme of the test `T` — the locus where the class named by `g` *is* a
   120	  chart value.  For the Abel chart this is `chartLocus`;
   121	* `r` recovers the chart point: over `W`, the divisor family whose class `g` is;
   122	* `sq` says the two ways round agree;
   123	* `exists_factor` is the honest content — a test point of `X` and a test point of `T` with
   124	  the *same* class come from a unique point of `W`.  Existence is coverage-on-the-locus;
   125	  the uniqueness half is *not* a field here, because it is free: `W.ι` is a monomorphism.
   126	
   127	Nothing in this structure mentions a divisor scheme, a certificate, a twist or a chart
   128	index.  It is a statement about a morphism of presheaves and an open of a test. -/
   129	structure ChartFibrePresented {X T : Scheme.{u}}
   130	    (f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   131	    where
   132	  /-- The locus of the test where the class named by `g` is a chart value. -/
   133	  W : T.Opens
   134	  /-- The chart point over that locus. -/
   135	  r : (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ X
   136	  /-- The square commutes: `r` names the class `g` restricted to `W`. -/
   137	  sq : yoneda.map r ≫ f = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   138	  /-- **Coverage on the locus**: an `S`-point of `X` and an `S`-point of `T` carrying the
   139	  same class factor through `W`, compatibly with both projections. -/
   140	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : S ⟶ X) (w : S ⟶ T),
   141	    f.app (op S) v = g.app (op S) w → ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}), u ≫ r = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   142	
   143	namespace ChartFibrePresented
   144	
   145	variable {X T : Scheme.{u}} {f : yoneda.obj X ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1}
   146	  {g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1}
   147	
   148	/-- **The datum presents the fibre product**: the square of `ChartFibrePresented` is a
   149	pullback of presheaves.
   150	
   151	Pullbacks in a presheaf category are computed pointwise
   152	(`IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app`), and a pointwise pullback of types is exactly
   153	"commutes + jointly injective + jointly surjective" (`Types.isPullback_iff`).  The first is
   154	`sq`, the third is `exists_factor`, and the second is free from `W.ι` being a
   155	monomorphism — which is where the openness of `W` does its work. -/
   156	theorem isPullback (D : ChartFibrePresented C f g) :
   157	    IsPullback (yoneda.map D.r) (yoneda.map D.W.ι) f g := by
   158	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   159	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   160	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   161	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1 =>
   162	      φ.app S) D.sq
   163	  · -- joint injectivity: already forced by `W.ι` alone, being a monomorphism
   164	    rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   165	    have : u₁ ≫ D.W.ι = u₂ ≫ D.W.ι := h₂
   166	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp this
   167	  · -- joint surjectivity: `exists_factor` at the test `S.unop`
   168	    intro v w hvw
   169	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   170	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   171	
   172	end ChartFibrePresented

   174	/-- **THE CRITERION** — `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` from elementwise data, discharging BOTH
   175	clauses of `MorphismProperty.relative` at once.
   176	
   177	Given, for every test point of the target sheaf, a `ChartFibrePresented` datum, the chart map

   179	divisors: the input is a family of opens of tests together with the coverage statement on
   180	each.
   181	
   182	This is the honest shape of `IsChartUniv`'s obligation.  Reading `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf`
   183	as a single "relative GAP-2" statement conflates:
   184	
   185	* **relative representability** — that the fibre product is a scheme at all.  Supplied here
   186	  by `W`, an open subscheme of the test, and proved by `ChartFibrePresented.isPullback`;
   187	* **the property clause** — that each represented pullback is an open immersion.  Supplied
   188	  here by `W.ι` being an open immersion, which is free.

   190	What is *not* free, and is the whole mathematical content, is `exists_factor`: a class that
   191	agrees with a chart value must come from the locus.  For the Abel chart that is the relative
   192	form of DAT-C GAP-2 (uniqueness of the normalized effective representative) fed through the

   195	theorem isOpenImmersion_presheaf_of_chartFibrePresented {X : Scheme.{u}}

   197	    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : yoneda.obj T ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1),
   198	      ChartFibrePresented C f g) :
   199	    IsOpenImmersion.presheaf f := by
   200	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists fun T g => ?_
   201	  exact ⟨(D T g).W, yoneda.map (D T g).r, (D T g).W.ι, (D T g).isPullback,
   202	    inferInstance⟩
